channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Reggie Evans | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Reggie Evans from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pete D'Alessandro on Reggie Evans
item.description:
The Sacramento Kings today acquired guard Jason Terry and forward Reggie Evans from the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for guard Marcus Thornton, according to Kings General Manager Pete D’Alessandro.

“Adding Jason and Reggie provides our roster with toughness and veteran leadership that will help this team continue to grow,”

Pete D'Alessandro on Reggie Evans, Feb 19, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Reggie Evans
item.description:
On the criticism that Lopez isn't a very good rebounder,Shaq said,

“I didn't rebound well, and nobody gave a fu*k... Reggie Evans, let that motherfu*ker rebound.”

Brook Lopez on Reggie Evans, Oct 28, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: LeBron James on Reggie Evans
item.description:
James said after the game.

“No one knows what it takes unless you've done it. You can't sit here and judge and talk about a team winning a championship unless you've done it. (Evans) hasn't done it. “I’m not going to sit here and give Reggie Evans a lot of press because that’s what’s going to happen,”

LeBron James on Reggie Evans, Jan 31, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.
